blurb: Guests can charter historic cable cars and streetcars, which are National Historic Landmarks, for private group events. Charters run on tracks only; no bus or motorized cable car charters are offered. Reservations are made via a lottery system with limited availability and are subject to cancellation due to city events or operational issues.
